XP Health | Senior Full Stack Engineer | ONSITE 2-3 days per week — San Carlos, CA | Full-time

XP Health is a Series B startup building the next generation of vision care. We're on a mission to revolutionize vision care through cutting-edge technology, including augmented reality, while ensuring a delightful and seamless user experience. We serve 3,000+ clients, including Fortune 500 companies, and have raised $50M+ in funding.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll own features end-to-end—from designing and shipping customer-facing experiences to building backend services, infrastructure, and developer tooling. You'll work closely with our founding team & help shape the technical direction of the platform. Our stack includes React, Node.js, and AWS, with opportunities to work across the full stack. Backend leaning, Startup, and AR experience is a plus.

$180K–$220K base + equity, bonus, and strong benefits.

Apply here: https://grnh.se/bhfswi9e5us
